Careers/Google + Amazon Specialist

Google + Amazon Specialist

Search, Performance Max and Amazon Ads as one connected stack.

  • Mumbai
  • Onsite
  • Full-time
  • Mid to senior, 4 to 7 years
  • Rs 18L to Rs 32L, OTE
Apply for this roleAll open roles

The role

Run Google and Amazon as one connected stack for our D2C brands: Search, Performance Max, Shopping and Demand Gen on Google, Sponsored Products and DSP on Amazon.

What you will own

  • Daily campaign management across Google and Amazon
  • Performance Max structure, asset feeds and budget allocation
  • Amazon Ads strategy across Sponsored Products, Brands, Display and DSP
  • Cross-channel reporting and attribution triangulation
  • Weekly creative briefs to the studio

You probably are

  • 4 to 7 years running Google and Amazon Ads at agencies or brands
  • Amazon Ads experience across India and the US is a strong plus

A bonus if you have

  • Looker or advanced GA4 reporting
  • Amazon DSP

How hiring works

  1. 0130-minute screening call with the Head of Performance
  2. 02A 90-minute case study you complete on your own time
  3. 03Final round, a 2-hour panel with founders and the team you'd work with
  4. 04Reference checks and an offer within 7 days
